_doc: Umbrella -> [child subtype slugs] for the verbatim_names_mapped_conditions rule. An UMBRELLA condition (e.g. cancer) counts as NAMED-BY-PROXY when a claim's verbatim names any registered CHILD subtype (e.g. leukemia) even if it never says the umbrella word. child->parent ONLY (naming cancer does NOT name leukemia). Luneth ruling SESSION 37 (2026-07-01): keep specific subtypes as their OWN condition tags (exact Wallach terminology) AND surface them under the umbrella; the umbrella is the intentional long-form 'library' of all its subtypes. Every proxy-satisfied mapping is listed by the umbrella_proxy_named info-invariant (human eye on each). Children must be REAL condition slugs; add conservatively (a wrong child would falsely satisfy the umbrella). memory verbatim-must-name-mapped-condition + condition-umbrella-taxonomy.
